name: Parameters.chiK_eq_one_of_dvd
summary: With 4p ∣ d(P) + 1, the Legendre symbol (p/d(P)) equals the Jacobi symbol (p | 4p − 1), which is 1.

steps.claim: χ_K(p) is the Legendre symbol (p/d(P)), i.e. the Jacobi symbol J(p | d(P)); reducing d(P) modulo 4p (`jacobiSym.mod_right'`), d(P) mod 4p = 4p − 1 since 4p ∣ d(P) + 1; and 1 = J(1 | 4p − 1) = J(4p | 4p − 1) (the upper entry is read modulo 4p − 1). So it remains J(p | 4p − 1) = J(4p | 4p − 1), together with the side conditions (p > 0, 4p ∣ d(P) + 1, d(P) odd).
steps.lean:
rw [chiK_eq_legendreSym, legendreSym.to_jacobiSym, mod_right', (Nat.mod_eq_sub_iff one_pos _).2,
    ← one_left (4 * p - 1), ← mod_left' (Int.add_emod_right 1 _)] <;>

steps.claim: These hold: 4p ∣ d(P) + 1 because p ∣ (d(P) + 1)/4 (`dvd_norm_c₀`) and 4 ∣ d(P) + 1 (d(P) ≡ 7 mod 8); J(4p | n) = J(4 | n)·J(p | n) = J(p | n) as 4 is a square.
